neighbours.label: the letter piece at the end of a letter range (-f, -F, -G in [a-fA-F0-9], A-F, A-G)
fire: The pattern accepts [a-fA-F0-9] digits and rejects the rest.
Hex values must match [0-9A-Fa-f]+ in this field.
Students receive grades A-F at the end of each term.
Volumes for the letters A-G are on the top shelf.
The token is made of [0-9a-f]+ characters only.
Sections A-E of the form must be filled in by hand.
Input must match [A-Fa-f0-9]{8} or it fails.
Files A-F are stored in the left cabinet.
quiet: The pattern accepts plain digits and rejects the rest.
Hex values must be lowercase in this field.
Students receive report cards at the end of each term.
Volumes of the old atlas are on the top shelf.
The token is made of letters only.
Sections of the form must be filled in by hand.
Input must be short or it fails.
Files for the audit are stored in the left cabinet.

short: end letter of a letter range
notes: Card: ' AF' x6, '.E' x3, ' F' x2, ' BE' x2, 'H' x2, ' E' x2, '-f' and '-G' in the top examples. Probes: '-f' 1.091, '-G' 0.681, '-F' 0.545, 'FE' in AFE 0.530, '.F' 0.345; 'lowercase characters' 0.003. Other F-initial cases (AFE, A.F.) are outside this label. Near misses keep the topic without a range.
